@Test
public void testDescribeVirtualTables() throws Throwable {
    assertRowsNet(executeDescribeNet("DESCRIBE ONLY KEYSPACE system_virtual_schema;"), row("system_virtual_schema", "keyspace", "system_virtual_schema", "/*
" + "Warning: Keyspace system_virtual_schema is a virtual keyspace and cannot be recreated with CQL.
" + "Structure, for reference:
" + "VIRTUAL KEYSPACE system_virtual_schema;
" + "*/"));
    assertRowsNet(executeDescribeNet("DESCRIBE TABLE system_virtual_schema.columns;"), row("system_virtual_schema", "table", "columns", "/*
" + "Warning: Table system_virtual_schema.columns is a virtual table and cannot be recreated with CQL.
" + "Structure, for reference:
" + "VIRTUAL TABLE system_virtual_schema.columns (
" + "    keyspace_name text,
" + "    table_name text,
" + "    column_name text,
" + "    clustering_order text,
" + "    column_name_bytes blob,
" + "    kind text,
" + "    position int,
" + "    type text,
" + "    PRIMARY KEY (keyspace_name, table_name, column_name)
" + ") WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (table_name ASC, column_name ASC)
" + "    AND comment = 'virtual column definitions';
" + "*/"));
}

@Test
public void diff311() throws Throwable {
    List<String> excludeObjects = //lazy initialization in 4.0
    Arrays.//lazy initialization in 4.0
    asList(//lazy initialization in 4.0
    "org.apache.cassandra.metrics:type=ThreadPools.*", "org.apache.cassandra.internal:.*", //it was deprecated in the previous major version
    "org.apache.cassandra.metrics:type=DroppedMessage,scope=PAGED_RANGE.*", // removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    "org.apache.cassandra.metrics:type=Client,name=connectedThriftClients", // removed in CASSANDRA-13910
    "org.apache.cassandra.request:type=ReadRepairStage", // removed in CASSANDRA-15939
    "org.apache.cassandra.db:type=HintedHandoffManager", // dropped tables
    "org.apache.cassandra.metrics:type=Table,keyspace=system,scope=(schema_aggregates|schema_columnfamilies|schema_columns|schema_functions|schema_keyspaces|schema_triggers|schema_usertypes),name=.*", ".*keyspace=system,(scope|table|columnfamily)=views_builds_in_progress.*", ".*keyspace=system,(scope|table|columnfamily)=range_xfers.*", ".*keyspace=system,(scope|table|columnfamily)=hints.*", ".*keyspace=system,(scope|table|columnfamily)=batchlog.*");
    List<String> excludeAttributes = // removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    Arrays.// removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    asList(// removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    "RPCServerRunning", "MaxNativeProtocolVersion", "StreamingSocketTimeout");
    List<String> excludeOperations = // removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    Arrays.// removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    asList(// removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    "startRPCServer", // removed in CASSANDRA-11115
    "stopRPCServer", // nodetool apis that were changed,
    // -> decommission(boolean)
    "decommission", // -> repairAsync
    "forceRepairAsync", // -> repairAsync
    "forceRepairRangeAsync", // -> beginLocalSampling(p1: java.lang.String, p2: int, p3: int): void
    "beginLocalSampling", // -> finishLocalSampling(p1: java.lang.String, p2: int): java.util.List
    "finishLocalSampling");
    diff(excludeObjects, excludeAttributes, excludeOperations, "test/data/jmxdump/cassandra-3.11-jmx.yaml");
}

@Test
public void cliHelpDiff() {
    ToolResult result = jmxtool("help", "diff");
    result.assertOnCleanExit();
    Assertions.assertThat(result.getStdout()).isEqualTo("NAME
" + "        jmxtool diff - Diff two jmx dump files and report their differences
" + "
" + "SYNOPSIS
" + "        jmxtool diff [--exclude-attribute <exclude attributes>...]
" + "                [--exclude-object <exclude objects>...]
" + "                [--exclude-operation <exclude operations>...]
" + "                [(-f <format> | --format <format>)] [(-h | --help)]
" + "                [--ignore-missing-on-left] [--ignore-missing-on-right] [--] <left>
" + "                <right>
" + "
" + "OPTIONS
" + "        --exclude-attribute <exclude attributes>
" + "            Ignores processing specific attributes. Each usage should take a
" + "            single attribute, but can use this flag multiple times.
" + "
" + "        --exclude-object <exclude objects>
" + "            Ignores processing specific objects. Each usage should take a single
" + "            object, but can use this flag multiple times.
" + "
" + "        --exclude-operation <exclude operations>
" + "            Ignores processing specific operations. Each usage should take a
" + "            single operation, but can use this flag multiple times.
" + "
" + "        -f <format>, --format <format>
" + "            What format the files are in; only support json and yaml as format
" + "
" + "        -h, --help
" + "            Display help information
" + "
" + "        --ignore-missing-on-left
" + "            Ignore results missing on the left
" + "
" + "        --ignore-missing-on-right
" + "            Ignore results missing on the right
" + "
" + "        --
" + "            This option can be used to separate command-line options from the
" + "            list of argument, (useful when arguments might be mistaken for
" + "            command-line options
" + "
" + "        <left> <right>
" + "            Files to diff
" + "
" + "
");
}
